desc: Boston University is the academic home of Laurence J. Kotlikoff, Professor of Economics, who co-wrote the three Forbes columns with Mark Skidmore that carried the unsupported-adjustment aggregate into financial-press circulation between December 2017 and January 2019. The institution has no other role on this board; it is recorded because the credibility of the Forbes pieces rested in part on the authors' academic affiliations, and because tracing where a claim acquired authority is part of tracing the claim.
